# Campuslit

> Campuslit (also written Campus Lit or CampusLit) is a free, open-source browser extension that redesigns the Bahria University student LMS (lms.bahria.edu.pk) and CMS (cms.bahria.edu.pk). Same logins and data, with a cleaner look, themes, due-date reminders, an attendance planner, a readable week time table with calendar export, and quick search (Ctrl+K). It is an independent student project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Bahria University.

Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kldmhhiopdefjapkebnelablimikghio (Chrome, Edge and Brave, on a computer; free; no sign-up).

## Key facts
- Works for students of every Bahria University campus, on lms.bahria.edu.pk and cms.bahria.edu.pk only.
- Features: six themes (Bahria, Crystal, Midnight, Linen, Grove, Bloom) and a custom-theme maker; Due soon card and assignment reminders on the LMS; attendance planner for the 75% rule and a week time table with Add to calendar on the CMS; quick search.
- Private: sends nothing to anyone, has no accounts or analytics, never reads passwords or form input. Optional notifications (off by default) read only the two portals, using the browser's own sign-in. Open source under the MIT licence.
- Optional notifications (off by default): attendance marked present or absent, quiz marks uploaded, new assignments, new lecture notes, and deadline reminders 2 days, 24 hours and 7 hours before.
- Firefox 140+ is supported by manual install; the Add-ons listing is not live yet.
